antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 850nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in beta_cell if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Dual-phase: Hsp70 activation (220 THz, 10^-12s) + CcO pulse (370 THz, 10^-15s, 30% amp) targeting fibroblast_ATP in beta_cell.
